sources.author: Fakh
patch_list: Makes "Login dengan Google" work by signing in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services. Needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google account.
Removes banner, feed, video and full-screen ads.
Stops the videos in the "Video Pilihan" block under an article from playing on their own. They play when tapped.
